name: opening-to-reactor-entrance
description: After New Game: press Circle for 4 frames every second until the picture has stayed the same, and not a single colour, for 5 s (300 frames), for at most 30000 frames (8 min 20 s). Circle does nothing in the opening movie; it advances dialogue, picks Attack and its target in a battle, and closes result screens; on a field where the player has control and stands still, it changes nothing. So the first 5 s still picture that ignores 4 or 5 presses is taken as the first controllable field (#74). Game-agnostic: no FF7 address is used. The wait's metric is still_wait, which the including scenario must list.
